text: Nora (PM): Quick follow-up from today's usability batch. Users keep calling the console UI 'Tag' while our docs and glossary say 'Version'. It's causing support churn when customers search for 'pin a tag'. Julian (Design): We shortened to 'Tag' in the table for density, but agree it causes discoverability issues. Proposal: change visible label to 'Version' and add an inline micro-link 'How to pin' that targets the docs pinning section. Keeps the row compact. Samir (Docs): Docs canonical term: 'model version'. I'll add an explicit H2 id '#pinning-flow' and also include a hidden alias anchor for legacy fragments: `` right before the H2. I'll add a one-line note at the top: "Console shows 'Version' (historically 'Tag')." Also adding search synonyms for tag/variant. Bea (Eng): Implementation notes: changing visible label is trivial. Fragments are client-side so Samir's hidden anchor is the right approach. To avoid telemetry churn, we'll keep the analytics event `model_tag_click` and map it to the new label in the UI layer. Julian (Design): Accessibility: inline link text should be descriptive for screen readers: `How to pin a model version`. Tooltip (if present) must be keyboard-focusable with `aria-describedby`. Avoid ellipsizing the label on narrow screensprefer wrap. Samir (Docs): Will add the alias anchor and glossary line in a PR. Suggest also adding a quick cross-link in the in-product docs panel top: "See glossary: version / tag / variant" so users land on the canonical definition. Nora (PM): Good. QA asks for an e2e that follows the inline link and asserts landing fragment + focus. Also add a manual regression case for analytics mapping. Bea (Eng): I'll add a tiny feature branch with the label change, aria attributes, and an e2e test: click 'How to pin' -> assert URL ends with `#pinning-flow` and `document.activeElement` is the H2. I'll include the analytics mapping in the PR description. QA-Bot: ticket-created: QA-4338. checklist: docs-pr: open soon, ui-branch: created, e2e: pending. Julian (Design): I'll upload two tooltip copy variants to Figma and mark the a11y-preferred one. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/console-help-microcopy (see frames 3/4). Samir (Docs): PR opened: adding alias anchor + glossary line. Will ping thread with PR link. Bea (Eng): UI branch created: `feature/label-version-inline-link`. I'll wait for docs merge, then land both together. No infra changes needed. Nora (PM): Timeline: aim for next minor. If docs anchor alias has issues we revert the UI text only. Thanks team. :thumbsup: Julian (Design): Tiny nit: change tooltip trigger to be focus-on-hover and click-to-toggle for screen readers. Will note in Figma. Samir (Docs): Note for support: I'll add a short FAQ line "If you see 'Tag' in screenshots, it's the same as 'Version' in the console." Bea (Eng): Adding automated check: when navigating to `https://console/.../models#tag` the hidden anchor ensures scroll lands on H2. QA to verify. Nora (PM): OK closing this thread; ping here when PRs merge or if QA finds regressions.
